name: Azure Wing: Rising Gale
source:
Based in a Dystopian future, a young soldier wakes up from stasis to find himself in a land he no longer recognizes, surrounded by primitive humans wielding nothing more then wooden sticks. 

  Being considered an "artifact" by these cave dwelling humans, he must find out what has happened in the time he has been frozen and how long he has been trapped in time.

   Armed with his battle suit, an Advanced A.I. named Joan and outdated knowledge of the terrain he once called his battlefield, he begins his journey to learn what has happened to his species and the world. 

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/125520822/azure-wing-rising-gale]Kickstarter page[/url]]
translation:
以反乌托邦的未来为背景，一名年轻士兵从静止状态中醒来，发现自己身处一片他不再认识的土地，周围都是原始人类，他们只挥舞着木棍。

  作为被这些穴居人类视为“神器”的他，必须弄清楚自己被冰冻的这段时间里发生了什么，以及自己被困在时间里多久了。

   一名高级人工智能装备着他的战斗服。他名叫琼，对他曾经称之为战场的地形的了解已经过时，他开始了他的旅程，了解他的种族和世界发生了什么。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/125520822/azure-wing-rising-gale]Kickstarter页面[/url]]
